_doc: Samurai Shodown II victim postures (export_bm.VICTIM_POSES['samsho2'], the vocabulary of tools/kof96/victim_poses98.json: posture + angle, ROM sprites face left, 0 upright, 90 horizontal head toward the facing side, 180 head down). Keys 'anim.step' of the thrown animations of handlers_ss2.throw (the victim's class 5 entries, in the thrower's own frames): Haohmaru's slash throw 508, kick throw 510 then 470, Genjuro's throw 514 (508 + 6: Haohmaru thrown by Genjuro); the flight 220 and lying 222 play the brawler's knockdown animations. Read by eye from the frames (sheet_ss2.py 0 508,510,470 / 12 514). The rage moves' caught victims (handlers_ss2.VL, the victim's own class 3 actions 36 / 115 / 116): Genjuro's WFT 464 (the flight) and 498 (carried in his spin), Kuroko's 580 (dazed at his place), 586 (dazed, his MAX's pose), 588 (the knock, 3 steps with his anim 7) (sheet_ss2.py 0 464,498,580,586,588). Hanzo (TODO #193, sheet_ss2.py 2 520,522,466,470,490,492,494,460): his slash throw 520 then the flight 466, his kick throw 522 then 470; Mozu Otoshi's caught victim (class 3 action 33): 490 (grabbed), 492 (lifted), 494 (spun head down, 4 steps), 460 (the burning flight).
